limitations: Ten selected CPU PRs from a 114-PR inventory; this is not universal or first-attempt conversion yield.

Focused behavioral tests and one final Sonnet attempt per task do not establish exhaustive correctness or difficulty calibration.
GPU-host bootstrap readiness is distinct from GPU task generation.
